value.answer: Microsoft is consolidating its Copilot apps into a single "super app" that will merge Copilot’s chat, coding, and agentic features. This new app will unify both consumer and commercial experiences, aiming to provide a simpler and more cohesive experience for users. The integration is part of a broader trend in the AI app space where companies are consolidating features to streamline user experience.
